en: "We have awaited you a long while.{n} With all our hearts, we have{n} longed to meet you."
"How very polite of you, thank youuu.{n} But who are you? By the look of you,{n} you seem to be from the East."
"Is there something you need from uuus?"
"I shall speak plainly.{n} Would you do us the favor{n} of fighting us?"
"But we can't just fight{n} for no reason at all, you knooow?"
"Point and reason matter little. The{n} law of heaven and the law of earth{n} call for a battle with you. No more."
"The battle is a one-on-one bout{n} with Toryu here at my side. Whoever{n} among you fights, we do not mind."
"I've seen clothes like those in a book.{n} You're a samurai, aren't you? A swordsman{n} of the East who values courtesy, I hear."
"I see. You would go against the{n} flow? So be it. Not forcing{n} others is a virtue of ours."
"Even so, we shall wait for you{n} here for as long as it takes."
"Should you change your mind,{n} please come to this place{n} at any time."
"I'm not keen on it, but I'll accept."
"There's no malice in your eyes.{n} Perhaps there's something you can{n} only tell us by crossing swords."
"You are just as rumor has it. You{n} see easily into others' hearts,{n} truly with the eyes of an angel."
"Oh no, that's not true at aaall."
"Oh, no, no, how very kind of youuu."
"I'm the one who accepted the duel.{n} I can't force it on my dear{n} companions, nooo."
"Leave it to me, {name:6}!{n} You'd be a bit too risky out there,{n} that's for sure!"
"Well, well, it cannot be helped.{n} Yet I too carry Eastern blood.{n} This battle looks rather amusing."
"I see. With my magic power, I can{n} hold my own even against a samurai.{n} Quite a sound decision..."
"No help for it! Watch closely{n} and see how I fight!{n} Kieeeeeeeeeeeeeh!"
"Target locked. Combat analysis start.{n} Stabilizer: high-speed mode.{n} 13B unit running at full output."
"I see. Through the fight with{n} Toryu, we have taken the measure{n} of your strength and your skill."
"I see. Just as rumor has it, you{n} are people of great strength.{n} This leaves nothing to be desired."
"I am Ozunu, a geomancer come from{n} Japone, a land in the far East."
"Oh my, you're a geomancer?{n} I've heard they use mysterious{n} powers, like wizards."
"But why would a geomancer like{n} you test uuus?"
"The ki of wind and water told me."
"At the center of this island of{n} steel, and deeper still, something{n} disturbs the ki of heaven and earth."
"I must see it with my own eyes!{n} This fearsome Almighty Treasure that{n} disturbs even a vast flow of ki!"
"But by our strength alone, we could{n} never hope to reach the center{n} of this island..."
"With the strong ones the wind and{n} water showed me, the way inland{n} will surely open."
"So thinking, we first challenged you{n} to battle, as a test of strength..."
"But I'm terribly sorry, buuut our goal{n} is to go and seal away{n} the Almighty Treasure, you seee."
"It's a little different from your goal."
"No, I do not mind even so."
"For I by no means desire{n} the Almighty Treasure.{n} I only wish to see it."
"You, surely, can see through to{n} my true heart. What say you,{n} Lady {name:6}?"
"It's true, I don't sense anything{n} evil in those eyes of yooours."
"Will you not let us join you{n} as your companions!?"
"I will welcome you both{n} as our companiooons!"
"This must be fate of some kiiind!"
"As I said earlier, I am Ozunu,{n} a geomancer come from Japone..."
"A geomancer is an adept who grasps{n} the flow of ki and commands{n} a variety of arts."
"My attack and stamina are a little{n} above a Western wizard's, so I can{n} manage some close combat as well."
"A samurai is, so to speak,{n} a knight of the East."
"Skilled with the sword, master of{n} special moves, a wielder of magic{n} too: one to rely on in battle."
"Of course, both Toryu and I{n} can operate Voids."
"From now on, please ask of us{n} whatever you wish."
"I'm terribly sorry, but I must decline."
"Our journey is a terribly dangerous{n} one. I can't drag someone from the far{n} East into a journey that dangerous..."
"So you would go against the flow{n} to the last? So be it. Not forcing{n} others is a virtue of ours."
"We shall take our leave, then.{n} May a fair wind blow for you."
"It seems the rumors were mistaken.{n} With strength of that order,{n} we are still the stronger..."
"What do you mean by that?{n} If you can, please tell me{n} what's going on."
"No, it is all over and done with.{n} We shall make for the center of{n} this island by our strength alone..."
"You're the Easterners from the other{n} day, aren't you? You're still heeere?"
"Our battle with you is the law of{n} heaven and earth. No one at all can{n} defy the flow that ki has decreed."
"A duel with Toryu here: will you{n} not accept it this time?"
"Me, getting pushed back?{n} Somebody cover me!"
"No! I can't give up now!{n} Hector, cover me, pleeease!"
"But I absolutely can't lose this!{n} Back me up, will you!"
"Backup! Backup!{n} Waaah! It hurts!{n} But Alice won't give up!"
"Well fought, for an enemy.{n} {name:6}, forgive me,{n} but I need your support!"
"Argh! Son of a bitch!{n} But I won't lose! Never again!{n} Backup! Send help!!"
"Am I... out of healing...?{n} ...Please... cover me..."
"Oh dear, this won't do...{n} I have run out of ways to heal."
"I'm a professor, you know!?{n} Show a little more care, will you!?{n} Hurry up and back me up!"
"Win probability down to 22%!{n} Auto-repair function: off!!{n} Requesting backup!"
"The flow of ki is gathering to the{n} enemy. I have no means of healing{n} left. Please, lend me your support."
"Lord, please send me aid!{n} I cannot lose here, for I{n} must spread Your teachings!"
"Ngh, they really are strong!{n} And I'm out of healing...{n} Backup, please!"
"Me, a soldier of Romulus, pushed{n} back by a mere foe like this...!{n} Sorry, requesting relief!"
"Li'l Tethys is in a piiinch!{n} Backup, if you please!!{n} Much obliged, yes indeed!"
"Guess they were...{w:1} way out of my league.{n} Sorry, I'm pulling out first!"
"Uu...{w:3} sniff...{w:3} sniff...{n} Alice...{w:3} lost...{n} Alice is going... {w:5}home..."
"Alas...{w:3} so I am beaten.{n} Forgive me, {w:3}I must withdraw."
"I can...{w:3} still fight...{w:3} I can...{n} ...Damn it! {w:3}Pulling back for now!"
"Pathetic...{w:3} Can't even die...{n} So once again, I alone {w:3}retreat...?"
"It seems...{w:3} over these centuries...{n} my magic, too...{w:3} has waned...{n} Allow me {w:3}to withdraw first!"
"Why...{w:3} did I...{w:3} lose?{n} I'm...{w:3} a professor, I tell you...{n} Retreat, {w:3}retreat! {w:3}Running is winning!"
"Damage rate...{w:3} 59.7%...{n} Self-repair {w:3}limit reached.{n} Moving to camp."
"I could not...{w:3} control the flow of ki...{n} ...{w:3}I can make...{w:3} no excuses.{n} I will...{w:3} return...{w:3} ahead of you..."
"Ah...{w:3} so I have lost...{n} Lord, {w:3}forgive me...{n} I will go back {w:3}to camp {w:3}ahead of you..."
"Ngh...{w:3} I'm sorry...{n} {hero:6}...{w:3} Lieutenant, sir...{n} I'm pulling back {w:3}ahead of you..."
"...{w:3}A proud...{w:3} soldier of Romulus,{n} beaten...{w:3} so disgracefully...{n} Sorry... {w:3}I'm withdrawing!!"
"Li'l Tethys loses!{n} Withdrawing, if you please!!{n} The rest is yours, yes indeed!"
"Tch.{n} So the enemy made off with the chest!"
"O blazing flames,{n} become a storm and destroy the foe..."
"...Deadly lightning, become a flash{n} piercing heaven and earth, and show{n} the murderous foe your true power..."
"...Thunder wind, become a blade raging{n} in the air, and show the horde{n} writhing on the ground your true power..."
"...Absolute ice, become storm fangs{n} that shake heaven and earth, and show{n} the oncoming malice your true power..."
"Water of light,{n} become a shield and guard us."
"Wall! O wall of swirling flame!{n} Bar the enemy's way and{n} grant us the power of protection!"
"Hear my name! Call my name!{n} A proud name, filled with glory!"
"Race across the sky! Pierce the heavens!{n} The ultra-long shot... Range Plus!"
"This one's no ordinary bullet!{n} Round in the chamber!{n} Hammer cocked! Target!"
"Rocks in the sky, clouds on the ground!{n} ......Art of Falling Rocks!"
"The gates connect, O eight gates!{n} ...Art of the Strange Gates...{n} Earth Formation!"
"Magic and strikes, be sealed!{n} Battle arts, be shut away{n} by the Law of Sealing!"
"Come, dragon, dragon of the earth!{n} Open, Gate of Death! Lead on to hell!"
"Come forth... my minions...{n} puppets of the dead...{n} The word that wakes you... Doll..."
